Barraza26LaborComposition.compositionCon.reason: The source proposition and its displayed Assumptions 1--3 were compared with the complete expanded target and all five displayed prerequisites. comparisonIndividualCondition preserves the interior asset point and positive fixed returns; the approved fixed-z and fixed-return conventions justify unary V, ellF, and ellI and scalar RF and RI. laborPreferencesCondition now expressly preserves every positivity restriction and the exact two-sector separable labor-cost formula for nonnegative hours. interiorRegularBranchCondition preserves differentiability and positivity of V at a, and, on the approved nhds representation of the source open neighborhood, positive formal and informal hours, slack Hbar, and both source FOCs. informalHoursShare is exactly ellI/(ellF+ellI). With d the derivative of V, the conclusion states the source derivative sI(a)(1-sI(a))(phiI-phiF)d/V(a); localConcavityCondition is exactly d<0 and yields the source's negative, zero, and positive cases for phiI>phiF, equality, and phiI<phiF. No source premise, admissible source case, formula, or conclusion is changed by the explicit labor-cost/separability premise.
